title: Player news
items: A small news icon now shows beside players with fresh news on My Team, Players and Boxes.
Open any player card to read the latest one or two updates: injuries, lineup changes, call-ups, hot streaks and more.
News comes from RotoWire via ESPN and refreshes every few hours.

title: Seasonal themes
items: The site now dresses up for the holidays all year: snow and lights at Christmas, a New Year's countdown and fireworks, hearts for Valentine's, shamrocks for St. Patrick's, spring for Easter, maple leaves for Canada Day, autumn leaves for Thanksgiving and spooky stuff for Halloween.
Each theme turns on and off by itself.
Opening Day gets its own baseball celebration.

title: Halloween theme
items: Bats, a ghost, a creepy spider and cobwebs haunt the site through Halloween.
It switches itself off on November 2.

title: Scores ticker
items: New scrolling MLB scores ticker right under the menu on the Home page, the same look as the other AASN pools.
Shows every game today: start times, then live scores and finals. The label turns red (LIVE) while games are on.

title: Team logos
items: Add your own team logo from My Team: upload a photo or paste a link to an image. It's cropped to a circle and goes live straight away.
Logos show next to team names in the standings and team pop-ups; teams without one get their initials. Tap any logo to see it full size.
The AASN bar shows the new AASN badge, and the site moved to aasn.theaahl.ca.

title: Player cards tidied
items: Player cards: the name now sits above the photo, the full headshot shows (no clipped caps) and it no longer covers the team logo.

title: Switch between pools
items: New AASN bar at the very top of the home page: jump between the AABL and the AAHL (hockey) pool in one tap.
Each pool shows a quick status, like games live or sign-ups open. Tap AASN for the network home page.
The Death Pool is in the AASN bar too, showing how many celebs are already in the graveyard.

title: Tiebreakers set
items: Ties are broken by most home runs + RBI from your hitters, then most strikeouts from your pitchers (current picks, only while they're on your team).
If teams are still tied, they split the prize money for the places they cover. Full details on the Rules page.

title: Live Tonight points
items: During games, the standings get a ● TONIGHT column with live points, updated every minute.
Ranks, totals and payouts include tonight's points while games are on (▲/▼ shows spots gained or lost tonight). The official points still come in the 4am update.
Team rosters show each player's live points tonight.
Today's games on the home page show live scores and innings.
The pick deadline is set automatically to the first pitch of Opening Day once MLB posts the start times, and picks lock on their own at that moment.

title: Install the app, paper entries and more
items: Payouts are live on the Standings page: the whole pot goes to the players (see Rules for the split).
Add the AABL to your phone's home screen like an app — look for the install banner.
New printable paper entry form (link on the Sign Up page).
Once picks lock, the Boxes page shows how many teams picked each player.
Hover or tap a stat abbreviation (HR, QS, HLD…) to see what it means.
Loading bar at the top while data loads.
New Privacy page under More.

title: Optional sign-in
items: Sign in with Google, Hotmail/Outlook, Yahoo or an emailed link — the same account works for the AAHL.
Signed in, My Team lists every team entered with your email, so you don't need your entry ID or email link. Signing in is never required.

title: More of the AABL is live
items: Records page: single-game highs, best games, the season 3 Stars tally, best team nights, Team of the Week and team history.
Rules page with the full scoring table, trade rules and the division-winner bonus.
IR List showing every pool player who is injured or out.
What's New (this page) so you can see what's changed.

title: Last Night, Stars of the Night and Players of the Week
items: New Last Night page: every pool player who played, their stat line and points, plus how each pool team did that day.
Home page now shows Stars of the Night, Players of the Week, Last Night's Performers and today's MLB games.

title: Sign up, My Team and trades
items: Sign Up: build your team from the 21 boxes and pick all 6 division winners. Your picks are saved as you go.
My Team: open your team from your confirmation email (or entry ID + email), make trades and change division picks before Opening Day.
Activity feed of every trade in the league (shown once picks lock).

title: Player cards with cut-out headshots
items: Tap any player for a full card with stats, a points breakdown and their team colours.
Headshots now have the grey background removed, like the AAHL cards.

title: Welcome to the AABL preview
items: Home, Standings (with points race and team compare), Players, Boxes and the 2027 MLB schedule.
Stats update every morning after the night's games.
